question.text: A Cat III AIF using 'Systematic Managed Futures' (CTA-style) deploys:

answer.text: Algorithmic/quant-driven futures positions across asset classes

explanation.text: The Logic: Systematic Managed Futures uses quantitative algorithms to take futures positions across asset classes. The Trap: Discretionary/fundamental-only approaches are different. Cross-Exam Context: CTA strategy tested in Topic 2. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Understand the algorithms' rules — black-box without explanation should raise concerns.
